analysis:
The PR modifies only docs/architecture/inference.md: a 'Last updated' date bump (line 3) and a new troubleshooting table row near head line 2556 about a Trace/BPT trap from a failed MLX runtime Metal kernel compile on M5 GPUs. The supplied units are base_text of unchanged surrounding sections (lines 806-1611); they cover GLM memory admission, deadlines, calibration and prefix-cache/engine descriptions. They contain none of the changed lines, so the new row text is visible only in the truncated patch excerpt.

No code, config, trust-boundary, key-handling, attestation, encryption or authorization behavior changes. The documentation introduces no new endpoint, secret, or exposure. The new row describes an availability failure (process crash on JIT kernel compile failure). That is a pre-existing runtime behavior being documented, not a regression introduced here, and it is a DoS-style local operational concern with no new attacker-controlled trigger shown.

The surrounding text touches T-041 (prefix cache), but the unchanged excerpts do not alter the SEC-035 accepted-risk posture (30-minute TTL, HMAC lookup tags, coordinator-authored cache scope). Several statements remain unverified contract claims about code outside this batch, e.g. the 0.10.3 fix and the cited libs/mlx-swift jit_kernels.cpp. The patch excerpt is truncated, so the full new row and any other head-side changes beyond the two reported ranges were not seen. The range map is marked complete, which supports docs-only impact. No findings; a docs-only change warrants no deeper review.
